voice_133:r_479b340ccc6c572b.text: Once I've made up my mind...!

voice_133:r_70b9c4b9f1f37eff.text: Eyes down! Let's do this, Genion!

voice_133:r_9fcb3754cb1773c7.text: It'll all be decided in an instant!

voice_133:r_cbab0f4720e1fcf1.text: Genion's power... I'll make it mine!

voice_133:r_0bbe0b4f5364e732.text: All my power in one instant...!

voice_133:r_5dda5198137cb02a.text: I'll overcome anything in my way!

voice_133:r_0f58a8822381e57f.text: I'll show you Genion GAI's power!

voice_133:r_4de4fcf3b440baf4.text: This power... I'll make it all mine!

voice_133:r_30fad37a42bd3ad3.text: Y-yes! I'm ready whenever you are!

voice_133:r_bf3244994760e535.text: Don't space out. The enemy's here.

voice_133:r_02479dc8fe989560.text: Don't think that was the end!

voice_133:r_a2df00f91a9b0a9e.text: Sorry, but my attack isn't over!

voice_133:r_48b60d6c48b9b142.text: I won't stop until I finish you!

voice_133:r_665f01666859013b.text: Don't expect mercy for a villain!

voice_133:r_a571eec59b258d11.text: I won't wage war!\nI'll wipe you out!

voice_133:r_ddbe581c5ea9183d.text: I'll teach you the eye-for-eye rule!

voice_133:r_6ff1323b355593e0.text: Using a girl as your figurehead...!

voice_133:r_b7b5625d7cd4282f.text: If you hate peace that much,\nfine!

voice_133:r_920740a0219c5085.text: Is war the only way you know?!

voice_133:r_a8451712c57c1a72.text: If you want war,\ndon't cry when hit!

voice_133:r_3633df5b7b8f47fa.text: I won't let you drop that on Earth!

voice_133:r_52dfc56b14b93551.text: This won't bring an end to war!

voice_133:r_1b9b2aab5cb104da.text: The royal guard... A worthy foe!

voice_133:r_cf41e8828a90cbdb.text: I'll test the Red Comet's legend!

voice_133:r_d5e0a2317c40d322.text: So that's why she's the Iron Woman!

voice_133:r_ec2ea17765052401.text: An alien presence... from that foe!

voice_133:r_41997412868c48c4.text: No need to think! I feel its malice!

voice_133:r_9e6cf4f389dae55c.text: They attack,\nI won't hold my fire!

voice_133:r_9e0c80ac7e33b459.text: Identity later! Take it down now!

voice_133:r_47d52a2839c71715.text: I've done plenty of pest control!

voice_133:r_eb7ae28b53dc033c.text: Kill or be killed!\nI won't waver!

voice_133:r_55417493fce1d347.text: I'll show you humanity's true power!

voice_133:r_7d724dbcc4451e10.text: We die out, or you do.\nLet's fight!

voice_133:r_8f60f6fc86db3107.text: I'll finish you before you dart off!

voice_133:r_b1de76a75a253c13.text: I won't underestimate a small unit!

voice_133:r_2a00f1044ad5cbaa.text: I'll show you how humans beat an AI!

voice_133:r_3dbeead1bd3164ef.text: A machine built to kill people?!

voice_133:r_98d15b8cc09bc915.text: I won't let the world end yet!

voice_133:r_46e86d000250e137.text: Your curse won't consume the world!

voice_133:r_cdbd128a5b4127cc.text: We have the power to beat despair!

voice_133:r_cfccaa1fbeda124c.text: You'll have to bear it for a moment!

voice_133:r_b1f8ec192b9c083a.text: I can't target the cockpit...! Then!

voice_133:r_ddafde4b065ced49.text: It's come to this.\nNo holding back!

voice_133:r_de1213040856c089.text: No matter who I face, I go all out!

voice_133:r_0c0775e051211840.text: Is that the enemy squad's ace?!

voice_133:r_a2afffe1c396f0b3.text: Ace or not, I won't back down!

voice_133:r_13c25fbdfddc8a24.text: If I can slip past the naval guns!

voice_133:r_42ba1ecb310b4bd7.text: If I can get in close, I can win!

voice_133:r_d692f1d420460a47.text: Can you bear the world's burden?!

voice_133:r_a5643cec86b18bd2.text: Your plan\nis forcing your ego on us!

voice_133:r_68f2dfab20a4a30e.text: The world won't serve your greed!

voice_133:r_9cedad8237480563.text: Force it is!\nJust as you wished!

voice_133:r_546c3d5937fbb7ee.text: Atone for your deeds with your life!

voice_133:r_2c9d94ba13c5fc50.text: I'll crush them with my own hands!

voice_133:r_dad38ee29af2df3a.text: Come on! I'll make you feel my fury!

voice_133:r_546de3fb6db156ea.text: That woman is our enemy, Sensei!

voice_133:r_d89011fe3e5d082a.text: Genion and I will surpass you!

voice_133:r_c958860b0676b1f5.text: I'll settle this with my own hands!

voice_133:r_6825fd1ff907bd22.text: I'll put an end to your sins!

voice_133:r_391aa56435d9dd6e.text: I know my way around a knife!

voice_133:r_862ef7385bf2abd4.text: One shot, one kill!\nI'll finish you!

voice_133:r_4e37f92e7d2fc62e.text: This has more reach than a knife!

voice_133:r_0a3fccb71ec6cf2a.text: With this power, I can beat anyone!

voice_133:r_63f429c5c68c0863.text: With this power, I can beat anyone!

voice_133:r_4824bea6bab3af67.text: Every last bit of that power...!

voice_133:r_b57d2d74233f889a.text: You'll see the realm of death!

voice_133:r_f16a3eb0bcaac082.text: With this power, I can do it...!

voice_133:r_58dd2826a199ef51.text: I can feel... the forbidden power!

voice_133:r_e7a8cd8ed5bc2d1b.text: Until I've destroyed all you are!

voice_133:r_ec349c8ea9511a18.text: I'll unleash all of Genion GAI!

voice_133:r_a25bf2676ecf9d83.text: Geminis, this is the end for you!

voice_133:r_3e87f6fc3ea65aef.text: This is Genion GAI's true power!

voice_133:r_e92920ba4b301b9f.text: Just do it! This'll finish you!

voice_133:r_a6fd676d8146501b.text: I'll fight on with this power...!

voice_133:r_34be00b434b42bea.text: Eye for eye! An eye for an eye!

voice_133:r_7eedcce1036b4f4a.text: My way is to pay you back double!

voice_133:r_e016bd611281c0a6.text: I won't let that hit go unpaid!

voice_133:r_c07813b8d06a7217.text: You forgot to hit and run!

voice_133:r_febe65de885f155a.text: I was taught to hit back when hit!

voice_133:r_3840c01b1a9bf34b.text: They hit us, we hit back, Sensei!

voice_133:r_bc1a77b291081b0f.text: I'd rather use that time to counter!

voice_133:r_689700a088dc2f5b.text: But don't chase them too far!

voice_133:r_01c80710474b30ae.text: This is no time to lose focus!

voice_133:r_870a7c766b4e2144.text: A friend's chance.\nI won't waste it!

voice_133:r_a9f39df34c38f5b3.text: Leave the rest to me, Sousuke!

voice_133:r_16669b320b466ffb.text: Kallen made an opening for me!

voice_133:r_f13d4928e70aad04.text: I won't let them hurt my ally!

voice_133:r_bf8c22ddf5e5ebc4.text: I'll use Genion as a shield!

voice_133:r_d99d6b303b9eca7a.text: Don't let your guard down, Shinji!

voice_133:r_05e4c8c66077e99e.text: I won't let you hurt my clubmate!

voice_133:r_8d9b4fc385aef7c5.text: It's my fault I can't counter...!

voice_133:r_5007f4e5632e10dc.text: I won't stay here and be a target!

voice_133:r_c6e2e5a0cf999610.text: Genion's more spent than I thought!

voice_133:r_4ae43494550cddb4.text: I know! You don't have to tell me!

voice_133:r_13209866a96cdb7e.text: I felt it before I had to think.

voice_133:r_20f27bcf531af7a7.text: If that's how you're coming at me!

voice_133:r_3360fe6adb1d6342.text: Read two or three moves ahead...!

voice_133:r_5102781c1e823018.text: I can't afford to take that hit...!

voice_133:r_ff4fca801d10da93.text: Cloud nine! This is the best!

voice_133:r_63532dbbd2c777da.text: Not my match...! Is that all?!

voice_133:r_366a1594371ae41a.text: You won't hit me that easily!

voice_133:r_add28b5abd18497e.text: The enemy can't\nkeep pace with us.

voice_133:r_9f1316eb7e761e5d.text: I'm moving that fast on purpose.

voice_133:r_b727ac590e5fc881.text: You mean it's an easy win.

voice_133:r_d23baf327f21df3d.text: Hurry up and chase the enemy!

voice_133:r_7eb1ff91e6dd4579.text: So what! You think that hurt?!

voice_133:r_37a8e35d923df797.text: We've got D-Fault on our side!

voice_133:r_c17bbeb7638f9448.text: I'll stop it with the field!

voice_133:r_2890b43c4f3875b2.text: Is this a game to you, Gadlight?!

voice_133:r_abadc65ae19c6a47.text: I'll leave the timing to you!

voice_133:r_6a33536cdb9e9c32.text: Was I too slow to react?!

voice_133:r_93b13f545db4d55e.text: The armor stopped it! No problem!

voice_133:r_49f278326a3ba3df.text: Focus!\nNext won't be just a scratch!

voice_133:r_cb6f5f32c512bd06.text: I'll focus on attacking for now!

voice_133:r_1908b4bfabaaf397.text: That did no damage!\nNo time for it!

voice_133:r_1f7722403476a2d4.text: At this level,\nGenion won't go down!

voice_133:r_d8066ba2d8e44a06.text: I won't cry out\nfrom a mere scratch.

voice_133:r_0309f797f7ea0e85.text: Too slow! What are you doing?!

voice_133:r_8f827a3995df8c8e.text: I'll be more careful next time!

voice_133:r_9de00ef7821f5fe6.text: While I feel pain, I can fight!

voice_133:r_68b64fdd6d26b6b1.text: We can handle the damage! Attack!

voice_133:r_e235a64e3e9a32ee.text: If we retreat, they'll exploit it!

voice_133:r_e79ecc1c01e8c89f.text: You hack! What are you thinking?!

voice_133:r_0307bd661d43d319.text: So the Geminis commander is strong!

voice_133:r_bbb8bd651042a9bf.text: I hate it, but they're strong!

voice_133:r_f2c3d6c2e5157100.text: We can't absorb the whole impact...!

voice_133:r_5719486984cbef30.text: We can take one or two more hits...!

voice_133:r_a04b5de0e98d451e.text: Not yet! I'm not dead yet!

voice_133:r_fd82c979e1dfdd1b.text: Flesh for bone... Now it starts!

voice_133:r_5347e0a72d1255e2.text: I won't lose to despair or fear...!

voice_133:r_1211f02e2cb813d7.text: I'm conscious, so I can fight! Go!

voice_133:r_8d0bd2f962a789cf.text: Dad and Sis unavenged,\nI won't die!

voice_133:r_b2b3fe6a1ef90b22.text: Hang in there! I'll go to my limit!

voice_133:r_ed479625c609215c.text: It's no use! The machine won't hold!

voice_133:r_46a24b503ef54eed.text: At least you must eject, Sensei!

voice_133:r_e2ba6cee6c8bdcd4.text: I still don't believe I've lost!

voice_133:r_2d0b63a973c98363.text: These foes...!\nEach one is an ace?!

voice_133:r_9764df0b825349fa.text: Annalotta!\nCome at me ready to die!

voice_133:r_b0e9708560e344ed.text: I can't win...?!\nCan't I beat them?!

voice_133:r_fe38b47bacf817c4.text: Even if I die, I'll take them down!

voice_133:r_790d1d04b0558fa4.text: Why would you go this far for me?!

voice_133:r_8a25bf55dcc36b04.text: Move, Genion! Move! One more hit!!

voice_133:r_a386e0756c8933b3.text: Advent gave me this chance! Move!!

voice_133:r_58bef1a0aaf888df.text: Great work, everyone. Rest up well.

voice_133:r_dcf8c4e08d63fab3.text: Play to unwind, then study and work!

voice_133:r_9629de991575f44e.text: Well then, we'll see you again!

voice_133:r_15761052eb1798f2.text: What do you mean by after?

voice_133:r_fbfcaa3fd878eb0a.text: Hibiki, where to? This isn't over!

voice_133:r_78ca5a0ee9cfa309.text: Hint: Beat Jigoku-hen to learn why.

voice_133:r_d1efc63b4a1fc079.text: So let's work hard and clear it!

voice_133:r_7f8711d74fb16724.text: Players, play at your pace. See you!

voice_133:r_9ba3709eca12d162.text: Where to? The battle isn't over!

voice_133:r_6568f75132195486.text: Sorry. You saw me at my worst.

voice_133:r_000ce8930518f31e.text: I fear this pause may end my fight.

voice_133:r_f95069a26971d7d5.text: I'll await you. Help me again.

voice_133:r_c5097560acb81f2e.text: Pauses may rust my volunteer spirit.

voice_133:r_74fcca5ee45fd33c.text: I'll wait. Let's clean up again.

voice_133:r_8500d3832579de2e.text: So this is the Sphere's power...!

voice_133:r_aeb4fbe7e48351ef.text: I'll draw the enemy's eyes to me!

voice_133:r_8dfb82a4602b98e8.text: I'll pin you right where you are!

voice_133:r_9dbe46085514147a.text: I'll separate it from its wingman!

voice_133:r_44f1048f1cf39126.text: I'll force this into a one-on-one!

voice_133:r_2b2e89ddeb2d22b2.text: I won't let its wingman assist!
